explanation: Main's publication identity rule (scripts/lib/studyRecord.mts) decides which paper is cited on study pages and the agent export, not QC or author-concordance evidence; its bundle-reader adoption leaves the fingerprinted or sealed evidence parsers alone. This change moves the HypoMap atlas file shape into the data-origin layout while hypomapAtlas.mts keeps the release integrity checks, and archives hypomap-release.json with the release source. QC review, evidence authoring and verification commands are unchanged.
